steps.title: Open Private DNS
steps.text: Open Settings, Network & internet, Private DNS. If you can't find it, search the settings for Private DNS.

steps.title: Choose the host name
steps.text: Pick Private DNS provider hostname, not Automatic, and enter this name.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Press Save. If it will not connect, check the name again.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.text: A few seconds after saving, run this check to see that the device uses this Endpoint.
